prompt:
Production cosmetic skin sprite sheet for Midlife Survivors. FIRST reference is the EXACT character identity and costume to preserve: The Cold War Cowboy, average middle-aged man, long wavy BROWN hair past ears to collar, rugged tired round face, subtle stubble and a half-lidded unbothered expression, tan cowboy hat with curled thin brim and pinched crown. Eyes must stay visible beneath brim. Dark slate/charcoal jacket with lighter highlights, pale blue/cream collared shirt, lanyard and blank badge, dark denim trousers, brown boots, cream/beige floppy disk and clip-on pager as the reference. NO glasses unless actually present in first reference; do not turn him into a young blond cowboy. SECOND reference is exact finish reference: retro rendered 9-to-5er. Same character and outfit, altered rendering only.
Output FIVE ROWS x EIGHT COLUMNS, safe evenly spaced grid of complete figures on solid flat exact opaque #FF00FF. Logical export448x300, cells56x60. Rows:0 DOWN walk,1 UP back view walk,2 LEFT walk,3 RIGHT walk,4 IDLE. Idle0-3 breathing with blink;4-7 raises his floppy disk, blows a small dust puff off it, lowers it, exactly matching normal sheet's fidget. Eight walk phases: contact,down,passing,up,opposite-leg contact,down,passing,up, arm movement opposite legs, one-pixel down bob. Keep identity and torso stable. Same top-down three-quarter angle, head size, body footprint and sole line as first reference. Full hat brim, boots and floppy always fit inside cells.
Look: late-1990s pre-rendered low-poly3D reduced to crisp pixels, faceted shoulders/head/hat, smooth stepped gradient shading, slight plastic sheen on hat and boots, soft left rim light. NO traditional continuous navy outline; just one-pixel darker material edge. No blur or antialiased magenta halo. No floor/cast shadow.
Palette only base #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #EF9347 #C45C4B #BFA8CF #F1B5BF plus these SAME six intermediate shades from retro9-to5er: #26304A #697789 #B5956C #D87849 #F7E4BB #6A463A. Neutral white balance, no sepia, no golden haze, no film tint. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks or real people. Blank disk label and badge.
correction: Edit the FIRST attached 8-column by5-row Cowboy sprite study. Preserve the entire character design, hat, brown hair, face, outfit, pose sequence, view directions, grid and magenta background. Change ONLY the held prop in every frame: it must be an unmistakable FLAT SQUARE beige 3.5-inch FLOPPY DISK, with dark charcoal rectangular metal shutter across the top third, a tiny rectangular label recess below, and one square write-protect notch near a bottom corner. NO CUP, no cup rim, no drink, no handle, no steam in any walk/breathing frame. The small held disk should be roughly8x9 native pixels and held facing outward at a slight angle. Row4 columns4-7 retain the action of bringing the DISK near the mouth, blowing a few dust particles only in column5, and lowering it. Second attached image is his normal character sheet, showing this disk prop. Keep late1990s pre-rendered faceted3D finish exactly, 18-color palette as before, neutral white balance, no navy outline, no shadow. No letters, words, logos, numbers or watermarks. Five rows8columns and magenta spacing unchanged.
nativeExport: Proportional sampling to 56x60 cells, eighteen-color exact palette, opaque magenta key background. No runtime edits.
